Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 40 Marrickville Town Centre Comm Precinct 40 - with IWLEP 2022 amendments.pdf

Clause 9.40.2 - heritage (heritage): To retain, as a minimum, the front portion of contributory buildings where they are contr ibutory to the heritage conservation area (HCA) and/or streetscapes.

Clause 9.40.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified heritage values of the Civic Precinct Heritage Conservation Area .

Clause 9.40.2 - height_limit (development_control): To ensure new development at rear upper levels is a maximum of five storeys and is designed to be subservient to retained portions of co ntributory buildings or infill development to the street building front.

Clause 9.40.2 - other (development_control): Where required, to ensure there are active commercial fronts to new buildings facing onto streets to create a vibrant and safe streetscape.

Clause 9.40.2 - parking (development_control): To facilitate efficient parking, loading and access for vehicles that minimises impact to streetscape appearance, commercial viability and vitality and pedestrian safety and amenity.

Clause 9.40.3 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains the HCA 30: Civic  Precinct Heritage Conservation Area . See Part 8 (Heritage) of this DCP for detailed controls and guidelines.
